name: InventorySort
title: Inventory Sort
author: Vatroslav
description:
Keeps your inventory sorted, also in the sell list when trading: items are grouped by type in the order of the inventory tabs. Within a type, weapons go by damage and armor by protection, strongest first, then everything by name.

Using, equipping and dropping still act on the item you see.

Turn it off in Settings > Game > Inventory Sort.
